text:
Olivia (Finance): Heads up — billing/quota update going live May 1. Key points: 72h overage grace, modest free-tier rate-limit bumps, promo credit expiry shortened for new credits. Full rollout plan below.

Matt (Eng): Quick Q: how does the grace window behave with multiple API keys?

Olivia (Finance): Grace is applied at the account level for billing; Console still shows per-key usage for debugging.

Jessica (PM): Numbers for free-tier rps?

Olivia (Finance): Free-tier: text endpoints 2 -> 4 rps, embeddings 1 -> 2 rps. No changes for paid/dedicated.

Sam (Support): How are we showing this to customers on invoices?

finance-bot: Example invoice lines we will add:
```
Usage: 1,250,000 tokens
Overage charged (post-grace): 10,000 tokens @ $0.0009 = $9.00
Grace-window protection: -10,000 tokens (no charge during grace)
```

Nina (Legal): Reminder: grace window is a billing convenience; updated TOS draft linked in doc.

Matt (Eng): API/webhook changes?

Olivia (Finance): We'll add a new webhook field "grace_window_expires_at" and a header for responses indicating grace status. Eng team will get the API contract in #eng-platform today.

Jessica (PM): Promo credits?

Olivia (Finance): New promo credits issued after May 1 expire in 180 days (was 365). Existing credits keep their current expiry. Expiry will be visible in Console and on emails.

Sam (Support): Any self-serve flows for extensions?

Olivia (Finance): Customers can request auto-approved 30-day extensions via support form for qualifying startups. Larger requests go to CS.

Jessica (PM): Rollout timeline?

Olivia (Finance): Internal docs + API headers next week, Console UI in two weeks, customer emails on 2026-04-24 (7 days before change). Friday sync 10:00 PT for a short briefing — recording will be available. Link to draft FAQ: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/grace-window-2026

Sam (Support): I'll update canned replies and internal KB. Will flag any incoming tickets here. :thumbsup:

Olivia (Finance): Thanks — please review the FAQ and add comments. If any messaging could confuse customers, ping me directly.
